title: Signal Powder
summary: The Gull Fleet keeps the old navy's signal powder on the Gull Isles. Lit at night, a colour is an order at sea, and the drowned were the navy's crews. Mistress Fane wants it in the harbour before anyone lights it.

steps.journal: Open two chests anywhere in the Gull Isles, on any floor. The fleet's stores in the sea cave are the likeliest place for its powder.

objectives.label: Chests opened in the Gull Isles

ready: Two chests of the Gull Fleet's signal powder. Take them to Mistress Fane in Tollhaven's square.
done: The powder burned the old navy's green: all ships, close on the light. Fane sank it off the jetty, a keg at a time.
